title: Descartes circle theorem: curvature relation for four tangent circles

problemStatement.plain: AVAILABLE: Formalize the Descartes Circle Theorem: for four mutually tangent circles with signed curvatures k1,k2,k3,k4 (curvature = +/- 1/radius, negative for a circle internally enclosing the others), (k1 + k2 + k3 + k4)^2 = 2*(k1^2 + k2^2 + k3^2 + k4^2). Recommended route: encode tangency of circles (center z in C, signed curvature k) and reduce the curvature relation to a ring/nlinarith identity; solving the quadratic for k4 gives the two Soddy circles k4 = k1+k2+k3 +/- 2*sqrt(k1k2 + k2k3 + k3k1). Distinct from Mathlib's Descartes' Rule of Signs (a polynomial-roots result). Not a named Mathlib result.
